scripts.api:dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter api start:dev
scripts.web:dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter web start
scripts.demo: pnpm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,yellow "pnpm --filter api start:dev" "pnpm --filter web start"
scripts.db:seed: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter api db:seed
